description:
Delete the `pub(crate)` issue-construction fixture in `domain/types.rs` once no library test calls it.

## Background

Shared test support (`crate::test_utils`) defines `fixture_issue(title, description)`, which drafts an issue and assigns it a random UUID. Copies with the same body still exist. The library copy is the `pub(crate)` `fixture_issue` in `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs`; the unit tests in that module itself are its last callers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs` defines no issue-construction fixture, and no production module does.
- [hard] REQ-02: The unit tests in `domain/types.rs` call the shared fixture and assert what they asserted before.
title: The library's own issue-construction fixture is deleted
